infra.description: The MCP Worker resource and the hosts, endpoint path, and Scopes both instances derive from.

tools.description: What this MCP Server offers: the tools, built fresh for one Token Principal. Knows nothing about HTTP or auth.

resource-server.description: The Resource Server: one fetch handler that publishes discovery, admits only valid Access Tokens, and serves the tools over stateless MCP.

entry.description: One file per host, each a few lines around the Resource Server: Cloudflare Worker, Node via srvx, Vercel Function.

mcp-server.description: Entries read configuration from infra and hand requests to the Resource Server, which serves the tools. Dependencies point down; tools never see the transport.
